title: Invariant-domain-preserving limiting with Adaptive Mesh Refinement for Legendre-Gauss-Lobatto Discontinuous Galerkin Spectral Element Methods
summary: We present an invariant-domain-preserving (IDP) treatment of nonconforming interfaces for Legendre--Gauss--Lobatto Discontinuous Galerkin Spectral Element Methods (LGL-DGSEM) with adaptive mesh refinement (AMR) on Cartesian meshes. The proposed methodology extends recently developed convex limiting and graph-viscosity frameworks for DGSEM to meshes containing hanging nodes. Starting from a conservative mortar formulation, we derive low-order interface fluxes that satisfy the requirements of invariant-domain-preserving discretizations.
